svg.title: How the agentic writer works
svg.text: One writer, eleven cold editors and an author who signs off:
the whole path for one guide, from the brief to the release.
what the writer reads before it drafts
never types an output: every number comes from a real run
red gate, no editors: fix and re-run first
each editor reads cold: file paths only, no history, no opinion
8 editors, one guide-editor subagent each, in order
NOT SATISFIED: back to Revise and re-run
the same editor, up to 3 rounds
substance outranks style: no cut removes a verified fact
running example; updates go to series/
series/ updated, so the next guide starts from it
the writer never ships: only the author tags a release
